findings.current: The boy who had wandered from place to place met a master one day and became the eighteenth successor of the Fire Gate Clan.
findings.defect: “Wandered from place to place” omits that the boy survived by begging for food, erasing the destitution central to Jeok Cheongang’s early life.
findings.rationale: 유리걸식 specifically describes roaming and begging for food, not merely traveling without a settled home.
findings.replacement: The boy who had wandered from place to place, begging for food, met a master one day and became the eighteenth successor of the Fire Gate Clan.
findings.source: 유리걸식하던 소년은 어느 날 스승을 만나 열화문(烈火門)의 십팔 대 계승자가 되었고

findings.current: If Jeok Cheongang dispelled part of Fear through his rage, Mungyeong overcame its oppression through his cool reason and insight half a step beyond.
findings.defect: “Half a step beyond” lacks an object and obscures the explicit comparison placing Mungyeong’s enlightenment half a step above Jeok Cheongang’s.
findings.rationale: 반 계단 위의 깨달음 contrasts Mungyeong’s superior martial enlightenment with Jeok Cheongang’s rage-based resistance.
findings.replacement: If Jeok Cheongang dispelled part of Fear through his rage, Mungyeong overcame its oppression through cool reason and enlightenment half a step above Jeok Cheongang’s.
findings.source: 적천강이 분노로서 피어의 일부를 해소했다면, 문경은 냉철한 이성과 반 계단 위의 깨달음으로 피어의 압제를 이겨 냈다.

findings.defect: The sound effect is formatted as spoken dialogue.
findings.rationale: The source is an environmental thunder sound, not a quotation or anyone’s speech.

findings.current: We had taken a little damage in the initial clash, but aside from the minor Internal Injury I had suffered while fighting the Dongting Fisherman and the cut on my shoulder, I was perfectly fine.
findings.defect: The draft changes the implied subject from Taekyung alone to the entire group, attributing damage to others that the source does not mention.
findings.rationale: The listed injuries are Taekyung’s, and the sentence concludes with his own physical condition; no collective subject appears in the Korean.
findings.replacement: I had taken a little damage in the initial clash, but aside from the minor Internal Injury I had suffered while fighting the Dongting Fisherman and the cut on my shoulder, I was perfectly fine.
findings.source: 처음의 격돌로 약간의 손해를 보긴 했지만, 동정어옹을 상대하며 입은 약간의 내상과 어깨에 입은 자상을 제외하면 멀쩡한 셈이다.

findings.current: The Mutated Water God Dragon hurriedly raised its head, but the water had already been spilled.
findings.defect: The Korean idiom is translated literally, producing unnatural English and momentarily suggesting actual spilled water.
findings.rationale: 이미 엎질러진 물이었다 means the situation could no longer be undone—the equivalent of saying it was already too late.
findings.replacement: The Mutated Water God Dragon hurriedly raised its head, but it was already too late.
findings.source: 변이된 수신룡이 황급히 고개를 쳐들었지만 이미 엎질러진 물이었다.

findings.current: the others had not yet completely escaped Fear’s influence, no matter how slight the difference between them.
findings.defect: The draft characterizes the differences as slight, while the source only says that the degree of influence varied.
findings.rationale: 차이는 있을지언정 concedes differences without specifying that those differences are small.
findings.replacement: the others had not yet completely escaped Fear’s influence, though the degree varied from person to person.
findings.source: 다른 이들은 차이는 있을지언정 아직 피어의 영향에서 완전히 벗어나지 못했다.

findings.current:
“You fucking bastard—!”

The instant Jeok Cheongang’s fist struck the Water God Dragon’s waist, his curse burst forth like a magic spell.
findings.defect: The generic insult flattens the source’s deliberately elaborate profanity, and the narration incorrectly says the already-spoken curse burst forth only when the fist landed.
findings.rationale: 개호로 썅노무 is a strong, colorful compound insult, while the Korean presents the curse as accompanying the launched fist rather than emerging after impact.
findings.replacement:
“You godforsaken son of a bitch—!”

Jeok Cheongang spewed the curse like a magic incantation, and his fist slammed into the Water God Dragon’s waist.
findings.source:
“이 개호로 썅노무-!”

마법 주문과 같은 욕설을 토해 낸 적천강의 일권(一拳)이 수신룡의 허리 부분에 격중한 순간.

findings.defect: “Thud” depicts a blunt impact, but the source sound indicates White Flame plunging deeply into the dragon’s eye.
findings.rationale: 푸욱 is the sound and sensation of a pointed weapon sinking deeply into flesh, completing the spear thrust described immediately beforehand.

summary: The draft is broadly faithful, but it omits Jeok Cheongang’s childhood destitution, blurs a hierarchy comparison, changes the subject of battle damage, weakens and mistimes a curse, and renders the final piercing impact as a blunt thud.
